**Next intervention: replace the widest-coordinate median fallback with a capacity-constrained split along the learned centroid separator.** Keep routing scores, beams, cell-size limits, SQ2/SQ8 arithmetic and replication unchanged. This is a falsifiable geometry hypothesis, not an established fix.

The [closed global24 result](/home/rb/worktrees/borsuk-prod-ready-v9/docs/research/performance-architecture-20260930/semantic-1m/hierarchical-cells/paired100k/global-leaf-probe/a0002/decision.md) makes another pruning sweep a poor next step: gains were only 10/29 truth hits, with unchanged p05. Perfect downstream ranking still cannot reach 98%. The 8.25/8.64 MB figures remain modeled whole-cell payloads; this probe measured local SOURCE reads.

I verified that the inspected module at `d716a16e` matches the experiment’s recorded source SHA. Read-only parsing of authenticated directory metadata produced:

| Finding | ReLAION | CoHere |
|---|---:|---:|
| Leaves | 291 | 281 |
| Widest-coordinate fallback splits | 50/290 = 17.2% | 95/280 = 33.9% |
| Leaf-mean norm, p05 / median / p95 | .666 / .775 / .866 | .832 / .855 / .882 |
| Mean leaf occupancy | 343.6 | 355.9 |
| Mean implied within-cell squared radius¹ | .400 | .268 |

¹For unit source vectors, \(E\|x-\mu\|^2=1-\|\mu\|^2\), subject to stored-mean rounding.

CoHere’s poorer coverage accompanies substantially more forced coordinate splits, despite less variation in centroid norms. This supports investigating the fallback; it does **not** establish that fallback frequency causes the coverage deficit. Neither centroid norm nor average radius describes elongation, multimodality or useful boundary populations.

Current routing uses
\[
s(q,\mu)=1+\|\mu\|^2-2q^\top\mu.
\]
Normalizing the mean instead gives \(2-2q^\top\mu/\|\mu\|\): a different representative score, not a correction justified merely by cosine inputs. Neither guarantees nearest-row coverage. Moreover, the retained [unit-prototype experiment](/home/rb/worktrees/borsuk-prod-ready-v9/docs/research/unit-prototype-nomination-20260928/decision.md) already improved an earlier CoHere layout by only **0.625 percentage points**, remaining at 93.0625% coverage. Its preceding multi-prototype arm also failed. Those results do not decide this layout, but weaken another normalization/minimum-summary trial as the common remedy.

**Exact change.** In [the fallback branch](/home/rb/worktrees/borsuk-prod-ready-v9/crates/borsuk/src/hierarchical_semantic_cells.rs:407), retain the existing two trained centers \(a,b\). For a node with \(m\) rows, compute
\[
\Delta_i=\|x_i-a\|^2-\|x_i-b\|^2,\quad
L=\lceil m/4\rceil,\quad
n_A=\operatorname{clamp}(\#\{\Delta_i\le0\},L,m-L).
\]
When the original assignment violates the balance constraint, order by `(Δ, source ordinal)` and assign the first \(n_A\) rows left. This preserves the learned direction while moving only the population required by the existing constraint. Recompute arithmetic-mean child representatives normally.

Identical samples or a degenerate separator retain the existing deterministic fallback. Do not change successful unconstrained splits, sample selection, four training iterations, radius ordering within leaves, or query policy. The substantive uncertainty is whether this separator preserves source neighborhoods better than the coordinate fallback.

**Cheapest no-cloud falsifier—proposed, not executed.**

1. Authenticate the exact frozen roots, directories, cell rosters, source-order map and canonical originals. Use local retained inputs only. Missing originals mean **input unavailable**, with no automatic download.
2. Per dataset, select the first eight internal nodes ordered by `SHA256(root_sha || directory_offset)` that have 513–2,048 rows and equal-sized children, allowing one row of rounding. Reconstruct the original deterministic training and split. Verify original child memberships exactly; retain only confirmed fallback nodes. Require at least four verified nodes per dataset; otherwise close **inconclusive**, without expanding the sample.
3. Within each retained node, compare the original coordinate split with the proposed constrained split on exactly the same rows and centers. No descendant rebuild. Select 128 source rows by a frozen hash order, excluding the trainer’s sample. Compute their local cosine 16-neighbor graph, excluding self. This is a source-geometry diagnostic, not benchmark-query truth or ANN recall.
4. **Predeclare the screening gate:** both datasets must reduce aggregate cross-child neighbor edges by at least 10%, without increasing the worst tested node’s cut fraction. Membership must remain complete, unique and within the existing balance bounds. Failure rejects this proposed neighborhood-preservation benefit; authentication/control-replay/resource failures are **INVALID**, not scientific rejection.
5. Bound the original job to **one CPU, 512 MiB charged memory, swap disabled, 180 seconds, 2 MiB output**, at most 32,768 parent rows across both datasets, and 1 GiB streamed authentication input. No query requests, GT, new index, cloud or parameter retries.

This test can reject the mechanism cheaply. Passing would justify one new-layout qualification; it cannot establish 98% coverage. The next query experiment must use a newly frozen panel and preserve the existing quality/resource gates. Changed geometry may change the primary/boundary union size, so charge actual cells and bytes rather than assuming the old union remains 24.

The retained research remains useful within its limits:

- [V139](/home/rb/worktrees/borsuk-prod-ready-v9/docs/research/v139-centroid-page-preflight-closeout.md) rejects unbudgeted threshold admission; this change adds no admission expansion.
- [V146](/home/rb/worktrees/borsuk-prod-ready-v9/docs/research/v146-unit-centroid-score-closeout.md) rejects scalable serving by exhaustive centroid scans.
- [V149](/home/rb/worktrees/borsuk-prod-ready-v9/docs/research/v149-contiguous-hierarchy-closeout.md) and [V150](/home/rb/worktrees/borsuk-prod-ready-v9/docs/research/v150-unit-centroid-graph-closeout.md) distinguish weak grouping and discovery/truncation losses. None qualifies the proposed split.
- [Fable/latency reconciliation](/home/rb/worktrees/borsuk-prod-ready-v9/docs/research/performance-architecture-20260930/semantic-1m/fixed48/architecture-decision-20261002/specialist-reconciliation.md) still motivates bounded metadata, locality and fewer dependent fetch stages. Its obsolete eager-router timings are not current forecasts. Even the optimistic halving of all measured POST CPU gave conditional p90 472.595 ms.
- The retained D384 paper mechanisms can motivate neighborhood grouping at D768/1000; their metrics and hardware do not establish ANN@100 or cold-object-store performance.

**100M resource consequences—all projections.** Let \(S=512\), occupancy \(u\), \(C\approx N/(uS)\), depth \(H\), selected cells \(P\le32\), and \(D_p\) be the codec’s padded dimension. Current whole-cell row width is
\[
b(D)=D+28+\lceil D_p/4\rceil.
\]

| Component | Formula and projected consequence |
|---|---|
| Cell storage | \(Nb(D)\): **98.8 GB at D768**; **128.4 GB at D1000**, where \(D_p=1024\). |
| Canonical maintenance tier | \(N(8+4D)\): **308 GB / 400.8 GB**, respectively. |
| Raw binary-tree prototypes | \(2(C-1)4D\): **1.20–2.40 GB at D768**, for full-to-half occupancy; excludes serialized metadata and containers. |
| Current resident-directory admission | For encoded directory size \(E\): retained \(R=4E+256(2C-1)+8(65536)\); preload adds another \(E\). This split change does not solve full-directory residency. |
| Payload GETs/bytes | WholeCell: \(G=P,\ B=\sum_j n_jb(D)\le PSb(D)\). At D768: **12,140,544 B for 24 full cells**, **16,187,392 B for 32**. Startup, retries and future paged directories are additional. |
| Query CPU | Routing \(O((8+24)HD)\); SQ2 scanning \(O(PSD_p)\); existing four-block/cell SQ8 refinement \(O(128PD)\), plus hashing, sorting and allocation. No latency follows directly. |
| Build RAM | Existing model: \(96N+16tD+64HD+4Sb(D)+16(65536)\), already **9.6 GB** from its row term alone. Candidate margin buffers require explicit admission verification. |
| Build CPU | Approximately \(O(NDH+ItDC+\sum_{\text{fallback nodes}}m\log m)\), with fixed sample \(t\) and iterations \(I\). Skew, source rereads and sorting remain material. |

Peak process admission must cover
\[
\sum_{\text{unique pinned generations}}R_g
+E_{\text{new during preload}}
+QW_{\text{query}}+M_{\text{delta}}+M_{\text{cache}}
+M_{\text{maintenance}}+M_{\text{runtime}}.
\]
Set swap to zero and bound pins explicitly; delay replacement when old readers prevent admission. Build storage must count authenticated inputs, old pinned objects, new output, partition/sort scratch, journals and upload buffers **once each**. At D768, original input artifacts plus one new cell payload already project about **505.6 GB**, before directories and additional retained generations. Current code rejects \(N>100k\) and \(D>768\); these formulas grant no extension or feasibility claim.

A surviving split changes memberships and physical order, requiring a new authenticated build recipe/version and immutable root; historical artifacts retain their original identities. Incremental maintenance must apply the same split policy to bounded affected cells, retain canonical originals, publish bodies before head CAS, pin coherent base/delta snapshots, and reclaim objects only after pins expire. Skew can amplify reassignment and rewrites. These lifecycle requirements remain separate qualification work.

No files were edited, native/corpus/GT experiments executed, AWS accessed, or consultations started. Root retains integration, execution and publication decisions; matched S3 Vectors/Turbopuffer superiority remains unestablished.
